Bayesian updating in the LOG DOMAIN is the textbook fix for exactly this underflow, it needs only ADD, SUB, GT, SEL and a table - all registered kinds - and at four fractional bits a log2 weight ranges over [-8, +7.9], a dynamic range of 2^16 instead of 2^4.
